title: Context-Masked Truncated Reasoning Audits for Answer-Key Dependence in LLM Tutors
abstract: arXiv:2607.04572v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) tutors may have access to teacher notes, answer keys, rubrics, or retrieved solutions while producing student-facing explanations. We study whether truncated reasoning probes can distinguish direct access to such private context from answer information carried by the written explanation. Using Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation (TRACE), we evaluate 1000 GSM8K problems under question-only, correct answer-key, and wrong answer-key contexts. When forced-answer probes retain the private key, answer-key TRACE AUC rises from 0.375 to 0.900, and the gold answer is recoverable with no explanation at all in 998 of 1000 cases. We then introduce a context-masked replay: answer-key-generated prefixes are probed under the corresponding question-only prompt. Masking reduces 10\% prefix accuracy from 0.997 to 0.126 and median AUC from 0.900 to 0.375, nearly matching question-only values of 0.113 and 0.375. On 746 pairs wh

translated_title: 面向LLM导师答案密钥依赖性的上下文掩码截断推理审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）导师在生成面向学生的讲解时，可能可以访问教师笔记、答案密钥、评分标准或检索到的解答。我们研究截断推理探针能否区分对这类私有上下文的直接访问与书面讲解中携带的答案信息。使用截断推理AUC评估（TRACE），我们在仅问题、正确答案密钥和错误答案密钥三种上下文下评估了1000道GSM8K问题。当强制回答探针保留私有密钥时，答案密钥TRACE AUC从0.375上升至0.900，且在1000个案例中有998个案例即使完全没有讲解也能恢复出正确答案。随后我们引入了上下文掩码重放方法：在仅问题的提示下对答案密钥生成的前缀进行探测。掩码将10%前缀准确率从0.997降至0.126，中位数AUC从0.900降至0.375，几乎与仅问题条件下的0.113和0.375相匹配。
tldr: 本文提出上下文掩码截断推理审计方法，用于检测LLM导师是否直接依赖私有答案密钥生成讲解，实验表明掩码后各项指标几乎降至仅问题基线水平，证明该方法能有效区分私有上下文直接访问与讲解中携带的答案信息。
